content:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1887654322 — Performance degradation detected in APAC inference cluster. p95 and p99 latency elevated since 2026-03-15T10:45Z. Paging on-call SRE (Maya). Severity: Sev2. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.local/apac-inference-latency
Maya: Acknowledged. Investigating now — pinging Raj from eng-runtime for kernel/cache angle.
Maya: Quick note: we have a spike in small-batch requests causing GPU saturation + KV cache miss rate jump.
Raj: I see it — KV cache miss rate jumped to 45% on apac-infer-03, GPU util ~97% across shard 2. Many 1-2 token requests (chat-starts).
Elena: Support seeing customer reports: multiple 5-12s responses and a few 504s. Logged tickets for AcmeCorp and BetaAI.
Sam: Prioritize customers with SLAs. AcmeCorp on dedicated capacity — need to confirm isolation. BetaAI is hosted.
Raj: Running quick probe on pool:
```
$ roverctl pool status apac-infer-03 --json | jq '.nodes[] | {id, gpu_util, kv_miss}'
# output: node-7 gpu_util: 97%, kv_miss: 48%
# node-8 gpu_util: 94%, kv_miss: 47%
```
Raj: Preliminary hypothesis: sudden request pattern change + prefix cache eviction (large model canopy rebuild) causing cold KV loads and tiny batches.
Maya: Mitigation plan: 1) scale apac pool +2 nodes, 2) add temporary routing policy to prefer EU for non-low-latency customers, 3) enable aggressive request-aggregation for small requests. Doing step 1 now.
Maya: Running scale command:
```
$ roverctl scale --pool apac-infer-03 --delta 2 --reason "sev2: scale to relieve tail latency"
Scaling request submitted -> op-9921
```
deploy-bot: Scaling op-9921 started: provisioning 2 gpus (A10x2). Estimated ready in 3m.
Raj: While we wait, toggling batching override to 50ms for chat endpoints to reduce tiny batches. Patch going now.
Maya: Patch applied: batching_override=50ms for route /v1/chat/generate (temp).
Olivia: Drafting status page update — suggested copy below. Please edit: 
"""
Incident: Increased inference latency in APAC region (mitigated)
Status: Monitoring (mitigation in place)
Impact: Some customers experienced elevated response times and a small number of request timeouts. No model correctness or data exposure.
What we're doing: Scaled APAC inference pool, applied temporary routing and batching changes, monitoring performance.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when fully resolved.
"""
Elena: Add: impacted endpoints: chat/generate (high freq small requests) and embeddings for some customers. Mention AcmeCorp & BetaAI as impacted (ops-approved).
Sam: Approve including customer list in internal comm only — external status page should not call out names unless we coordinate legal. Keep external: "select customers".
Olivia: Updated external status blurb to remove names, internal note kept. Drafting customer email template now.
Olivia: Customer notification draft: 
"""
Hi — we experienced elevated inference latency in APAC earlier today which may have affected response times for some requests. We've applied mitigations (scaling and routing) and latency is improving. We will follow up when the issue is fully resolved and with a summary of root cause and remediation. Sorry for the disruption.
"""
Elena: Add line: "No data loss or model output correctness issues detected."
Maya: Scaling completed (op-9921 done). New nodes joined apac-infer-03. Observability: p99 trending down but still above baseline.
Raj: Confirmed: KV miss rate dropping to 12% after cache warm; GPU util down to ~70%. Batching change reduced request count per second by ~18%.
Maya: Implemented temporary routing rule to prefer EU fallback for non-SLA traffic:
```
PATCH /api/v1/routing/policies/temporary
{
  "match": "customer_tier != 'enterprise'",
  "prefer": "apac",
  "fallback": "eu",
  "ttl": 3600
}
```
deploy-bot: Routing update applied (route-op-542).
OpsRotation: I'll take watch for the next handoff window at 11:00Z. Next on-call: OpsRotation, will monitor p95/p99 and error rates.
Maya: Monitoring dashboards show p95 back to near-baseline in 8m, p99 improving. I'll keep alert thresholds lowered for 1h.
Raj: Opening post-incident ticket: assign to eng-runtime for root cause and caching tuning. Preliminary RCA: cache eviction behavior plus bursty tiny-batch traffic.
Olivia: Posting external status update as "Monitoring — mitigations applied" now. Internal thread updated with customer template.
Elena: Sending customer outreach for hosted customers with observed errors in next 30m. Support will personalize if needed.
Maya: Handing off to OpsRotation at 11:00Z. Action items for handoff: 1) watch p99 for 30m, 2) revert batching override if it causes regressions, 3) remove routing fallback after stabilization, 4) collect traces for Raj.
OpsRotation: Acknowledged — taking over.
Maya: Thanks team. Assign postmortem to Raj and include eng-runtime, eng-sre, and support. I'll add timeline and logs.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1887654322 status updated -> mitigated; monitoring. Postmortem assigned: ENG-INC-1887654322. Next automated reminder in 1h.
Raj: Quick note for postmortem: capture prefix eviction histograms, sequence-length distribution for the spike, and customer request rate patterns.
Olivia: Will attach status page and customer email thread to the postmortem.
OpsRotation: Marking incident as hands-off after 11:30Z if metrics stable for 30m.
Maya: Closing active paging loop. If we see reappearance, escalate to Sev1.
Olivia: Final external update scheduled in 60m with summary and next steps.
Elena: Support queue notes updated with sent template and affected ticket IDs.
Raj: Thanks — will follow up with a technical mitigation proposal (cache TTL tuning + adaptive batching) in the postmortem.
